purpose_context: The docsite moves from DocFX to doc-kitty (epic #6100, ADR 2026-10-31-1). Four frontmatter classes in docs/ stop doc-kitty from building the real tree: audience path strings, related repository paths, ADRs without doc_status/kind, and related entries naming unpublished pages. This mission migrates them mechanically, ports the core scripts that read those fields in the same change, and proves the immutable ADR/plan/report/changelog bodies did not change.
purpose_tldr: Make the real docs/ tree build on doc-kitty by migrating the build-blocking frontmatter, keeping DocFX and docs query working.
